reading.title: How We Use Our Voices
reading.purpose: Learn how to use your voice well in class.
paras: We use our voices in many ways. In the library, we whisper. We try not to mumble, so friends can hear. The teacher may announce a plan.
If you do not like it, you may complain politely or suggest a new idea. Never interrupt. Wait, then reply. If you promise to help, keep your word.

choices: break in while someone is speaking.
qs.why: Never interrupt means to wait and not break in when a friend speaks.

qs.q: Why should we try not to mumble?
qs.why: The reading says we try not to mumble so friends can hear.

qs.q: What should you do after someone finishes speaking?
qs.why: The reading says to wait and then reply.

reading.retellFrame: In class, I can whisper, wait, and ___.
